reasoning: Read both implementations end to end. GroupKokkos::angmom_kk (group_kokkos.h:347-413) unwraps only the position -- 'auto unwrapKK = DomainKokkos::unmap(l_prd,l_h,l_triclinic,x_i,d_image(i));' -- and then uses the raw velocity: 'l_px += massone * (dy * static_cast<double>(d_v(i,2)) - dz * static_cast<double>(d_v(i,1)));' in both the rmass and the per-type branch. Group::angmom (src/group.cpp:1501-1512) calls the six-argument 'domain->unmap(x[i], v[i], image[i], mask[i], unwrap, vunwrap);' and accumulates with vunwrap, and that overload (src/domain.cpp:1943-1967) adds 'if (deform_vremap && mask & deform_groupbit) { u[0] += h_rate[0]*xbox + h_rate[5]*ybox + h_rate[4]*zbox; ... }'. DomainKokkos declares only the position-only unmap (src/KOKKOS/domain_kokkos.h:80,130) and 'grep h_rate|deform_vremap src/KOKKOS/group_kokkos.h' returns nothing, so nothing compensates. Reachable through fix_momentum_kokkos.cpp:135 ('fix momentum ... angular') and fix_addtorque_group_kokkos.cpp:98. The divergence is zero unless 'fix deform ... remap v' is active AND the atom has a nonzero image flag, which is exactly the case Domain::unmap's six-argument form exists for.
fix: Add a DomainKokkos::unmap overload that also returns the corrected velocity -- taking prd, h, h_rate, triclinic, deform_vremap, deform_groupbit, x, v, image and mask as captured scalars -- and use it in both branches of angmom_kk in place of the raw d_v reads, mirroring Domain::unmap(x,v,image,mask,y,u).

reasoning: vcm_kk (group_kokkos.h:307-329) is the only reduction in the header that multiplies in KK_FLOAT before widening: 'KK_FLOAT massone = d_rmass(i); l_px += static_cast<double>(d_v(i,0) * massone);' (and the same in the mass/type branch at :325-328) -- the product is formed in KK_FLOAT and only the result is cast. The siblings all widen the operands first: mass_kk 'l_one += static_cast<double>(d_rmass(i));' (:56), xcm_kk 'double massone = static_cast<double>(d_rmass(i));' (:105), angmom_kk 'double massone = static_cast<double>(d_rmass(i)); ... massone * (dy * static_cast<double>(d_v(i,2)) ...)' (:369, 381). KK_FLOAT is float in the single and mixed precision builds (kokkos_type.h precision block), where the accumulator type is deliberately double. Group::vcm (src/group.cpp:1200-1205) does the products in double. So in a mixed-precision build every term is rounded to float before summation. Real, but the error is one float rounding per term on a quantity that is itself derived from float velocities, so the practical impact is small.
fix: In both branches of vcm_kk use 'double massone = static_cast<double>(d_rmass(i));' (resp. d_mass(d_type(i))) and 'l_px += static_cast<double>(d_v(i,0)) * massone;', matching xcm_kk/angmom_kk.
